description: Robby the chef has lots of endearing qualities. He can make over 5000 dishes, he’s a consistent cook, and he’s never late for work. But he’s not a human. It is a 750 lb. stainless steel robot. With a rotating wok at its center. It’s a wok-bot. Automation has changed many industries. But automation only started entering restaurant kitchens in the past couple decades. Which raises the question – what will robots mean for the restaurant industry? classificationReason: Substantial coverage of a robotic cooking system and its effects on restaurant work, automation, and food production.
qualityReason: Focused reported episode combining a real restaurant demonstration, human-versus-robot comparison, economist analysis, labor statistics, operating costs, throughput, taste tradeoffs, and worker perspectives. Evidence of technical robotics expertise is limited, but the reporting and structure are strong.
